title: Admin lists silently stop at 1,000 rows (products and inventory)
detail: PostgREST returns at most 1,000 rows, but the catalogue has 1,253 products and each store has 1,253 inventory rows. About 253 products never show on the Products page. On the Inventory page, products whose stock row was cut off show 0 stock and appear low. If staff save such a row, staff_set_stock writes price_override = NULL and wipes the real store price. The lists need server-side pagination and search.
evidence: supabase/config.toml:10 max_rows = 1000 (hosted Supabase has the same default). packages/api/src/admin.ts products.list and inventory.forStore have no .range() or pagination, and forStore has no ORDER BY. supabase/seeds/catalog.sql:2 says '1253 products' and :3779 seeds inventory for every store x product. apps/admin/src/app/inventory/page.tsx:61 uses quantity={i?.quantity ?? 0} and override={i?.price_override ?? null}. supabase/migrations/0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_set_stock sets price_override = excluded.price_override.
verifier_note: Checked and correct. supabase/config.toml:10 sets max_rows = 1000. In packages/api/src/admin.ts, products.list orders by name with no .range(), so the roughly 253 products last in alphabetical order never load. inventory.forStore has no ORDER BY, so which 1,000 rows come back is arbitrary. One more effect the reviewer missed: apps/admin/src/app/inventory/page.tsx builds its rows from products.list, so those same 253 products are missing from the Inventory page too, not only from the Products page. Rows whose stock record was cut off render quantity={i?.quantity ?? 0} and override={i?.price_override ?? null}. Saving one calls staff_set_stock (supabase/migrations/0005_staff_rpcs.sql), which overwrites both quantity and price_override. Search is done in the browser on the truncated list. Fix: server-side pagination with search (ilike or search_text) for both lists.

title: Store staff can rewrite any order column directly, skipping the staff RPCs
detail: An RLS policy lets any store_staff UPDATE every column of orders straight from the browser (for example total, status='delivered' or rider_id). That skips advance_order, so stock is not reduced, COD is not marked captured and no order_events row is written. This is a cash-fraud and data-integrity hole. The same broad 'staff write' policies let store_staff change delivery fees, create coupons and edit prices for every store. The orders UPDATE policy should be dropped, with all order writes going through staff_* RPCs, and settings, coupon and price writes limited to admins or managers.
needs_from_owner: Decide which actions store_staff may perform and which are admin-only.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:451 'orders staff update' ... using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff()), with no column limit. Lines 432-438 give store_staff full write on stores, coupons, products and inventory. No later migration drops or alters any policy (grep 'drop policy|alter policy' finds nothing).
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:451 'orders staff update' uses is_staff() for both using and check, with no column limit. Lines 432-438 give store_staff FOR ALL, which includes DELETE, on stores, categories, brands, products, inventory, banners and coupons. No migration drops or alters a policy, and there are no column-level grant or revoke statements. A worse hole on the same theme, which the reviewer missed: 0001_init.sql:421 'profiles self update' only blocks role changes, so any customer can update their own profiles.wallet_balance (and phone, referral_code, referred_by) from the browser. They can then pay with ration_wallet, which is offered at checkout in apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx:148 and apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx:212. place_order trusts that balance. Fix: drop the orders update policy, restrict the profiles update policy to full_name and email (column grants or a trigger), and limit store, coupon, price and delete writes to admins.

title: Image uploads from the admin have no Storage policies (likely broken in production)
detail: uploadImage writes to the product-images and banners buckets with the staff member's login token and upsert:true. No storage.objects insert, update or select policies exist anywhere in the repo. Supabase Storage rejects uploads that no policy allows, so photo upload on the products, categories and banners pages will probably fail with a row-level-security error. That is the page needed to fill the 811 missing photos. Check this on the local stack, then add policies that allow is_staff().
evidence: packages/api/src/admin.ts uploadImage. supabase/config.toml [storage.buckets.product-images] and [storage.buckets.banners] create the buckets only. grep 'storage.objects' in supabase/ and scripts/ finds nothing. No admin upload test: tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts covers customer and rider only.
verifier_note: No storage.objects policies exist anywhere: grep across supabase/, scripts/ and infra/ finds only the bucket definitions in config.toml lines 70-78. admin.ts uploadImage uses the staff member's login token with upsert:true, so it needs insert, select and update policies. Supabase rejects this with a row-level-security error. I could not test it on the local stack because Docker is not running in this environment. docs/FEATURE_PARITY.md claims image upload is 'Same, local', but nothing tests that. The impact is wider than products: banners/page.tsx refuses to save without an uploaded image, so no banner can be created, and category images also go through this upload. Workaround for products: CSV import (products/import, staff_import_products) accepts image_url, and scripts/photos sets external Wikimedia or Open Food Facts URLs. Owner-taken photos still need upload. The fix is a single small migration.

title: No order editing for missing or damaged items, substitutions or partial refunds
detail: If one item is missing at packing, the only option is to cancel the whole order. The order total is fixed when the order is placed, and on COD orders the rider app asks the rider to collect the full order total, so the cash taken cannot match the order. A staff_edit_order RPC and screen are needed to remove or reduce lines, recalculate the bill (coupon minimum, fees), release reserved stock, log an event, and refund the difference to the wallet or gateway, with an optional substitution after calling the customer.
needs_from_owner: Substitution policy (call the customer first, or auto-substitute up to the same price) and how short-picked COD orders are billed.
evidence: The only staff RPCs are staff_advance_order, staff_cancel_order, staff_assign_rider, staff_set_stock, staff_set_role and staff_dashboard (0005) plus staff_import_products (0010). apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx shows items read-only. apps/rider/src/app/order/[id].tsx:123 asks the rider to confirm 'you received formatInr(o.total)'.
verifier_note: Confirmed. The staff RPCs are staff_advance_order, staff_cancel_order, staff_assign_rider, staff_set_stock, staff_set_role and staff_dashboard (0005), plus staff_import_products (0010). orders/[id]/page.tsx shows items read-only. On COD orders, apps/rider/src/app/order/[id].tsx:123 asks the rider to confirm receiving formatInr(o.total). It is worse than the reviewer said: the customer-facing policy promises a feature that does not exist. apps/web/src/app/refunds/page.tsx:11, apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx:31 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/support.tsx:16 say missing or damaged items reported within 24 hours 'from the order page' are refunded to the wallet instantly. There is no report-issue flow (mobile order/[id].tsx:187 only links to the account tab) and no staff wallet-credit RPC. A first version could be: remove or reduce lines before packing, recalculate the bill, release reserved stock, and credit the wallet.

title: Cash / UPI-on-delivery reconciliation has no admin screen (known item, confirmed)
detail: Riders see 'Cash to deposit' and are told to deposit at the store, but nothing records who holds the cash. There is no deposit table, no screen for store staff to acknowledge a rider's deposit, no shortfall view and no end-of-day close. advance_order marks the COD payment 'captured' as soon as the order is delivered. When UPI on delivery is added, the admin also needs to record which mode the customer paid in.
needs_from_owner: Cash handling process (who receives the cash, the daily bank deposit) and the store UPI ID or QR code from the bank.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0006_rider.sql rider_summary.cod_collected_today (rider-only). apps/rider/src/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:25 'deposit at the store at end of shift'. 0003 advance_order: update payments set status='captured' ... provider='cod'. The admin NAV in apps/admin/src/components/shell.tsx has no cash or finance page, and grep reconcil|deposit|cash in migrations finds no table.
verifier_note: Confirmed. rider_summary.cod_collected_today in supabase/migrations/0006_rider.sql is visible to the rider only. apps/rider/src/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:25 says to deposit at the store. The NAV in apps/admin/src/components/shell.tsx has no cash or finance page. No deposit or settlement table exists in the migrations. advance_order (0003) sets the COD payment to 'captured' on delivery, regardless of what was actually collected. Also: rider_summary uses date_trunc('day', now()), which is UTC, so the rider's 'today' total resets at 05:30 IST. Because order editing does not exist (item 5), any short-delivered order will also show a cash mismatch.

title: No tool to process customer account deletion requests
detail: The web and app privacy text promise deletion on request through support, but there is no RPC, function or admin action for it. orders.user_id references profiles without cascade, so deleting a customer who has orders fails. An anonymise-customer RPC is needed (clear name, phone, email, addresses and push tokens, keep order and invoice records) plus a button on a customer page. Play Store's data-deletion policy and the DPDP Act both expect this.
needs_from_owner: Data retention period and privacy policy wording (the grievance officer is still null in packages/shared/src/company.ts).
evidence: apps/web/src/app/privacy/page.tsx:13 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx:24. grep 'delete.*account|anonymi' across supabase/, packages/ and apps/ finds nothing. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql orders.user_id references public.profiles (id) with no ON DELETE.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/web/src/app/privacy/page.tsx:13 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx:24 promise deletion on request. No RPC, edge function or admin action exists. orders.user_id, wallet_transactions.user_id and the referred_by self-reference point at profiles with no ON DELETE, so a plain delete fails once the customer has orders. orders.address_snapshot also keeps the name and phone. Addition: Google Play requires a way to start deletion from inside the app plus a web URL. apps/mobile/src/app/account/support.tsx has only call, WhatsApp and email links, so the app needs a 'Delete my account' entry point as well as the admin anonymise RPC. At low volume the admin side could start as a documented SQL procedure.

title: Admin hosting and access protection not set up (adds detail to the known deployment item)
detail: There is no Cloudflare build setup for the admin: next.config.ts has no static export or adapter, and the dynamic client route /orders/[id] cannot be statically exported without generateStaticParams, a query-string route, or an adapter such as OpenNext. env.ts silently falls back to http://127.0.0.1:54321 and 'local-dev-anon-key' when the environment variables are missing, so a misconfigured production build would ship pointing at localhost. The admin should sit on its own subdomain behind Cloudflare Access or a second factor, because staff login is SMS OTP only.
needs_from_owner: Cloudflare account, admin subdomain, and the list of staff emails or phones allowed through Access.
evidence: apps/admin/next.config.ts (no output or adapter). No wrangler or OpenNext config in the repo (find wrangler* finds nothing). apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx uses useParams. apps/admin/src/lib/env.ts fallbacks. apps/admin/src/app/login/page.tsx uses SMS OTP only. .github/workflows/ci.yml builds the admin but never deploys it.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/next.config.ts has no output setting or adapter. There is no wrangler or OpenNext config in the repo. orders/[id]/page.tsx uses useParams with no generateStaticParams. apps/admin/src/lib/env.ts falls back to http://127.0.0.1:54321 and 'local-dev-anon-key'. The login page uses SMS OTP only, with shouldCreateUser false. .github/workflows/ci.yml builds the admin but never deploys it. Helpful detail: every admin page is 'use client', and there is no middleware or route handler, so a static export plus Cloudflare Access works once the [id] route becomes a query-string route. The first admin is created by hand with SQL (README.md:77). The data itself is protected by RLS, so Cloudflare Access is an extra layer, not the only protection.

title: Customers can set their own wallet balance (and referral fields)
detail: The 'profiles self update' policy only stops a user changing their role. Any logged-in customer can call update profiles set wallet_balance = 9999999 through the public API, then pay for orders with ration_wallet and get goods free. They can also set referred_by to bypass apply_referral_code's checks. Fix: column grants (allow only full_name, email and avatar_url) or a trigger that blocks the other columns.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:421 (policy checks only role). No column-level grant/revoke on profiles anywhere (grep 'grant|revoke' in supabase/migrations). place_order takes wallet payment from profiles.wallet_balance (0003_orders_rpc.sql:198). packages/api/src/profile.ts update() writes profiles directly.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:421 'profiles self update' only pins id and role. No column grant or revoke and no profiles trigger exist anywhere (I grepped supabase/, scripts/ and infra/; the only grants are function EXECUTE grants). place_order debits profiles.wallet_balance (0003_orders_rpc.sql:198), and both checkouts offer ration_wallet. A user can also set referred_by to their own id: reward_referral_on_delivery (0004:41-44) then credits that one profile once but writes two 5000-paise ledger rows. They can also change phone and referral_code. packages/api/src/profile.ts:30 only sends full_name and email, but RLS is the only real control.

title: Picking an online method without Razorpay keys leaves a ghost order and uses up the coupon
detail: place-order runs the place_order RPC, which commits the order, reserves stock and records the coupon use, before it checks Razorpay config. With no keys (the launch setup), every 'Pay online' attempt leaves a pending_payment order holding stock, and WELCOME50 is used up, so the COD retry fails with COUPON_ALREADY_USED. The web checkout pre-selects 'online'. The payments on/off switch must be checked on the server before the RPC runs (for example an app_settings table that also holds handling and small-order fees, which are now hard-coded in SQL and TypeScript).
needs_from_owner: Decide which payment methods are on at launch
evidence: supabase/functions/place-order/index.ts:45 (RPC) runs before :60 razorpayConfigFromEnv. apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx:34 useState('online'). 0003_orders_rpc.sql per_user_limit check counts coupon_redemptions. No settings or feature-flag table (grep app_settings/feature_flag: none). HANDLING_FEE is hard-coded in packages/shared/src/pricing.ts and as v_handling 500 in place_order.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/functions/place-order/index.ts:45 runs the place_order RPC (it reserves stock, inserts coupon_redemptions and commits) before razorpayConfigFromEnv at :60 throws RAZORPAY_NOT_CONFIGURED. The client never receives order_id, so its PaymentCancelled to cancel-order path (apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx:60-65, apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx:77-80) never runs. packages/api/src/orders.ts:166 then tells the user 'Choose cash on delivery', and the COD retry gets a new idempotency key and fails COUPON_ALREADY_USED (0003:156-158). Both web (checkout/page.tsx:34) and mobile (cart.tsx:36) pre-select 'online'. No settings table exists (grep app_settings/feature_flag: none). HANDLING_FEE and SMALL_ORDER_FEE are hard-coded in packages/shared/src/pricing.ts:7-8 and in place_order (v_handling 500, 2000 at 0003:81,141). Note: WELCOME50 comes from supabase/seed.sql, which is dev-only, but the bug applies to every coupon.

title: Recording cash / UPI collected on delivery, and a rider cash ledger
detail: payment_method has only 'cod' for pay-on-delivery. Delivery marks a COD payment as captured but stores no record of whether it was cash or UPI, the UPI reference, who collected it, or when the rider handed the cash in. 'Cash to deposit' is just a sum of order totals for the day, so shortfalls cannot be traced. Needs a new method or collected_via field, a rider_cash_deposits table, and an RPC for staff to confirm a deposit.
needs_from_owner: Store UPI VPA / QR for collection and the daily cash hand-in process
evidence: 0001_init.sql payment_method enum. 0003_orders_rpc.sql advance_order sets payments.status captured only where provider='cod'. 0006_rider.sql rider_summary.cod_collected_today = sum(total). apps/rider/src/app/order/[id].tsx:123 confirmation only advances status. No deposit or settlement table in any migration.
verifier_note: Confirmed. The payment_method enum (0001:21) has only 'cod' for pay-on-delivery. advance_order (0003:349) just sets payments.status='captured' where provider='cod'. The rider screen apps/rider/src/app/order/[id].tsx:123 shows a 'Cash collected?' confirm and then only advances the status; nothing records cash vs UPI, a UTR, the collector or the time. There is no UPI or QR anywhere in apps/rider or apps/admin. rider_summary (0006) cod_collected_today = sum(total), and that total includes the tip, so 'Cash to deposit' (apps/rider/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:53) also asks riders to hand in their own tips. No deposit, settlement or reconciliation table exists.

title: Account deletion: no backend, and foreign keys block it
detail: There is no delete-account RPC or edge function. Apps tell users to 'ask via contact page'. Google Play and the App Store require in-app account deletion. Deleting the auth user would also fail for anyone with an order, because orders.user_id, wallet_transactions.user_id, coupon_redemptions.user_id and order_events.actor_id reference profiles with no ON DELETE rule. Needs anonymisation (scrub name, phone, addresses and address_snapshot, keep invoices) and then auth.admin.deleteUser.
needs_from_owner: Retention period for invoices (tax law) to confirm what is kept
evidence: grep delete_account/deleteAccount: none. apps/web/src/app/privacy/page.tsx:13 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx:24 ('ask us'). 0001_init.sql orders.user_id / wallet_transactions.user_id references public.profiles(id) with no cascade, profiles.id on delete cascade from auth.users.
verifier_note: Confirmed. No delete-account RPC or function exists (grep found nothing). apps/web/src/app/privacy/page.tsx:13 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx:24 say 'ask us'. These foreign keys have no ON DELETE rule: orders.user_id (0001:243), wallet_transactions.user_id (:324), coupon_redemptions.user_id (0003:12) and order_events.actor_id (:289). Two more the reviewer missed: profiles.referred_by (:42) blocks deleting anyone who referred a user, and orders.rider_id (:259) blocks deleting a rider. Apple does not accept a deletion process that runs only by contacting support, and Play also wants a web deletion link.

title: Product legal declarations missing from the products schema
detail: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) rules require e-commerce listings to show manufacturer/packer/importer, country of origin, net quantity, unit sale price and best-before. Food listings also need FSSAI details. products has only name, unit_label, mrp, price and tax_rate, so neither the CSV import nor the apps can carry these fields.
needs_from_owner: Per-product declaration data from suppliers. Company FSSAI licence number
evidence: 0001_init.sql products table. 0010_product_import.sql column list. grep manufacturer/country_of_origin/fssai/best before in migrations, packages and apps: none (only a note in supabase/catalog/README.md:99 about the meat licence).
verifier_note: Confirmed. products (0001:148-168) plus 0004 rating columns and 0009 orderable/image_credit have no manufacturer, packer, importer, country of origin, net quantity (unit_label is free text), unit sale price, consumer-care, best-before or FSSAI fields. The staff_import_products column list (0010) and the admin CSV COLUMNS (apps/admin/src/app/products/import/page.tsx:13) cannot carry them either. The only mentions are planning notes in supabase/catalog/family-classification.csv. The store's own FSSAI licence number also has no place in COMPANY. This is needed before the real catalogue goes live.

title: Backend production setup and backups
detail: Known item, confirmed. There is no Supabase cloud project, no workflow to deploy migrations or functions, and no backup job. Production also needs manual steps that are not scripted: secrets, Auth Send-SMS hook URL, set_notify_config in Vault, webhook URL, and auth rate limits. Daily backups require Supabase Pro or a pg_dump job.
needs_from_owner: Supabase account and plan (Pro for backups/PITR), region choice (Mumbai), production secrets
evidence: supabase/functions/README.md (manual deploy commands). .github/workflows has only ci.yml and two catalog-photo workflows. grep pg_dump/backup: none. 0008_notify_trigger.sql needs a manual set_notify_config call.
verifier_note: Confirmed. .github/workflows has only ci.yml, catalog-images.yml and catalog-auto-photos.yml; none runs supabase link, db push or functions deploy. Deploy is manual per supabase/functions/README.md. There is no pg_dump or backup job (grep: none). set_notify_config must be run by hand (0008). Also unscripted: Auth production config. config.toml has site_url 'ration://', a localhost redirect, test OTP numbers and the send-SMS hook pointing at host.docker.internal, and Supabase's default SMS rate limits are low enough to throttle real logins. supabase/seed.sql adds a TEST01 'anywhere in India' store that must never reach prod. Outside the backend: apps/rider has no eas.json (only apps/mobile does), and apps/web and apps/admin have no Cloudflare (OpenNext) adapter config.

title: No Storage policies, so admin image upload fails
detail: The product-images and banners buckets exist, but no migration adds storage.objects policies, so Supabase Storage rejects uploads from staff sessions. Product, category and banner upload in the admin panel will fail. Catalogue photos are also hotlinked from Wikimedia/OpenFoodFacts rather than copied into our own storage.
evidence: supabase/config.toml:70-79 buckets. grep 'storage.objects' in supabase/: none. packages/api/src/admin.ts uploadImage. supabase/seeds/catalog.sql image URLs point to thumb.wikimedia.org and images.openfoodfacts.org.
verifier_note: Confirmed, and worse than stated. supabase/config.toml:70-79 creates the buckets, but there is no storage.objects policy anywhere in the repo. The admin uses user sessions with no service role (only scripts/oss-start.mjs uses that key), and uploadImage uses upsert:true (packages/api/src/admin.ts:256-259), so INSERT, SELECT and UPDATE policies are all needed. Banners can only be created by uploading (apps/admin/src/app/banners/page.tsx:26 'Upload an image first'), so no banner can be added at all. Products and categories (products/page.tsx:41, categories/page.tsx:30) are upload-only too, which leaves the CSV image_url column as the only way to fill the 811 missing photos. Seed images hotlink thumb.wikimedia.org and images.openfoodfacts.org. Raised to launch-blocker: the fix is a small migration and the feature is broken today, which FEATURE_PARITY.md does not reflect.

title: Store price override can go above MRP, or to zero or below
detail: The per-store 'Store price' in the admin inventory screen has no check at all. Selling above the printed MRP is an offence under the Legal Metrology Act. A typo such as '-5' gives a negative line total, which lowers the customer's whole bill. place_order charges this price as it stands.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql: inventory.price_override has no CHECK (products only has price <= mrp). 0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_set_stock does not validate p_price_override. apps/admin/src/app/inventory/page.tsx StockRow takes free text through toPaise() in apps/admin/src/components/ui.tsx, so '-10' becomes -1000 paise. 0003_orders_rpc.sql place_order uses coalesce(v_inv.price_override, v_product.price) with no MRP comparison. search_products and the catalogue API show the same override price to customers.

title: Replace the sample catalogue with the real store assortment and prices
detail: Every product, pack size, MRP and price in the database is sample data written from an assortment document. Nothing lets the store's real day-one range be checked against it. The known 'missing photos' item and the ops 'production starting data' item (categories, stores, first admin) do not cover replacing the products themselves.
needs_from_owner: The real list of items the first dark store will stock, with actual brand, pack size, MRP and selling price from suppliers
evidence: supabase/catalog/README.md says '1,245 sample products ... **sample** prices'. supabase/catalog/image-tracker.csv marks 'Pack Size Verified: No (sample listing)'. supabase/seeds/catalog.sql is the only product source. supabase/catalog/pinned.json fixes prices that the e2e tests depend on. Produce has made-up MRPs (vegetables-fruits.json: Potato 1 kg, MRP ₹50, price ₹39).

title: Customers can set their own wallet balance
detail: The profiles update rule only stops users changing their id and role. Any logged-in customer can therefore set wallet_balance to any amount (and also change referred_by and phone) using the app's own Supabase connection, then pay for orders with 'RATION wallet'. That means free groceries and real money lost.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:421 (the 'profiles self update' policy checks only id and role). Line 43: wallet_balance column. Searched all migrations for a column grant or BEFORE UPDATE trigger protecting wallet_balance and found none. apps/mobile/src/app/account/profile.tsx updates profiles directly. apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx offers ration_wallet.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:421 'profiles self update' WITH CHECK only compares id and role. No column GRANT/REVOKE on any table in migrations or seed.sql, and no BEFORE UPDATE trigger on profiles; the only trigger is set_updated_at at 0001:376. place_order in 0003_orders_rpc.sql:198 debits whatever wallet_balance holds, so a user can PATCH profiles.wallet_balance and then pay with ration_wallet. The same hole lets a user write referred_by directly, which skips the apply_referral_code checks in 0004 (even pointing it at their own id), and change referral_code and phone. Fix: revoke UPDATE on profiles from authenticated and grant UPDATE on (full_name, email, avatar_url) only, or add a guard trigger. Add a smoke.sql test for it.

title: No in-app account deletion
detail: Google Play and Apple both require that users can delete their account from inside the app, and Play also wants a web link for it. The Account tab only has Log out, and the privacy text tells users to ask support. Deleting a user who has orders would also fail today: orders.user_id points to profiles with no ON DELETE rule, so the feature needs a design that strips personal data but keeps order records (it cannot simply delete the row).
needs_from_owner: How long order and invoice records must be kept after a user deletes their account (tax-law retention)
evidence: apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/account.tsx (rows: orders, addresses, wallet, support, legal, log out). apps/mobile/src/app/account/legal.tsx privacy text: 'ask us to delete your account ... from Help and support'. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:243 'user_id uuid not null references public.profiles (id)'. Searched supabase/ for delete_account / deleted_at / anonymi: nothing found.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/account.tsx has only Log out. legal.tsx:24 and apps/web/src/app/privacy/page.tsx:13 tell users to ask support. Nothing in the repo matches delete_account, deleted_at or anonymi. Several FKs to profiles have no ON DELETE rule: orders.user_id (0001:243), wallet_transactions.user_id (0001:324), coupon_redemptions.user_id (0003:12), referred_by (0001:42), orders.rider_id, order_events.actor_id. Deleting the auth user cascades to profiles and then fails on these. The design needs an anonymise RPC or edge function that strips name, phone, email and addresses, deletes push_tokens, keeps orders, then removes the auth user. The website also has no deletion page, and Play requires a web URL for deletion.

title: App icon and splash screen are Expo template placeholders
detail: icon.png and the Android adaptive icon are Expo's default blue 'A' logo. splash-icon.png is the blank white template image. The stores would show the Expo logo, and Play/App Store may reject the app as unbranded or misleading.
needs_from_owner: RATION logo and brand artwork: 1024px icon, adaptive foreground and background, monochrome version, splash image

title: No Supabase cloud project or migration/function deploy pipeline
detail: The project has never been linked, and nothing runs `supabase db push` or `supabase functions deploy`. razorpay-webhook, send-sms and notify-order only work if someone remembers the --no-verify-jwt flag at every deploy, because config.toml has no [functions.<name>] verify_jwt = false entries. Other one-off steps live only in READMEs: the Send-SMS hook URL and secret, set_notify_config, and the site_url and redirect URLs for the web domain. The project needs the Pro plan (Free pauses after a week of inactivity and has no backups) and the Mumbai region for data residency.
needs_from_owner: Supabase account on a paid plan, region choice (ap-south-1 Mumbai), GitHub Actions secrets (SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, DB password, project ref)
evidence: supabase/.temp has no project-ref (only cli-latest). supabase/config.toml: site_url = "ration://", additional_redirect_urls only localhost, no [functions.*] blocks. supabase/functions/README.md lists the manual deploy commands. No deploy job in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/.temp holds only cli-latest, with no project-ref. supabase/config.toml has site_url = "ration://", only localhost redirect URLs and no [functions.*] verify_jwt blocks. supabase/functions/README.md lists the manual deploy steps with --no-verify-jwt and set_notify_config. ci.yml has no deploy job. Refinements: (a) package.json functions:serve and scripts/oss-start.mjs:115 run the local functions with --no-verify-jwt for every function, so local testing never checks JWT verification. Adding verify_jwt = false only for razorpay-webhook, send-sms and notify-order in config.toml fixes both problems. (b) Running `supabase config push` from this config.toml would copy the local test OTPs, the ration:// site_url and the local hook URI into the cloud project, so production auth settings need a separate config. (c) Choosing Mumbai is good for latency, but it is not a legal data-residency requirement for a merchant (DPDP does not require localisation, and RBI payment-data storage rules fall on Razorpay), so that point is overstated.

title: EAS and store setup incomplete for both apps (push will not work in store builds)

evidence: apps/mobile/app.json and apps/rider/app.json have no 'extra'/'owner'. apps/rider has no eas.json. apps/mobile/src/lib/push.ts calls Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync() with no args. package-lock.json has no expo-updates. apps/mobile/eas.json submit has Android only.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/mobile/app.json and apps/rider/app.json have no extra.eas.projectId or owner. apps/rider has no eas.json, and apps/mobile/eas.json is the only one in the repo. apps/mobile/src/lib/push.ts:35 and apps/rider/src/lib/push.ts:35 call getExpoPushTokenAsync() with no projectId. title: Production login settings not hardened: SMS rate limits, captcha, DLT, store-reviewer access
detail: config.toml is local-only (1-second resend, fixed test OTPs). App Store and Play reviewers need a fixed-OTP test number and a serviceable demo address, because real stores only cover a small Bengaluru radius.

title: No way to record cash vs UPI at the door, and no rider cash ledger

title: Account deletion page and action
detail: Google Play requires a web link where users can ask for account deletion, and the privacy page promises deletion 'from the contact page'. The contact page only shows an email address and explains no process, and the account page has no delete option. There is also no backend function that deletes or anonymises a user.

Even deleting a user by hand in the Supabase dashboard would fail for anyone who has ordered: orders.user_id references profiles with no ON DELETE rule (0001_init.sql:243), while profiles cascade from auth.users. title: Checkout payment options are hard-coded, with 'Pay online' selected by default
detail: Checkout always lists 'Pay online via Razorpay' and selects it by default. Without a GSTIN or Razorpay keys, every customer who keeps the default gets a RAZORPAY_NOT_CONFIGURED error. There is no admin switch to turn online payments on or off and no 'UPI on delivery' option, because the payment_method list in the database has no such value. This confirms the known UPI-on-delivery and payments-switch items for the website.

verifier_note: Confirmed, and worse than reported. checkout/page.tsx:34 defaults to 'online' and :145-148 hard-codes the three options. The payment_method enum (0001_init.sql:21) has no 'UPI on delivery' value, and no settings or feature-flag table exists. The reviewer missed this: place-order/index.ts runs the place_order RPC first (line 45) and only then calls razorpayConfigFromEnv, which throws RAZORPAY_NOT_CONFIGURED (_shared/razorpay.ts:18). So every attempt leaves behind an orphan 'Awaiting payment' order that keeps its stock reserved and its coupon redemption. When the customer retries with cash on delivery using the same coupon, they get COUPON_ALREADY_USED, because per_user_limit counts the orphan's redemption (0003:156). The app has the same default (apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx:36, 206).

title: Price shown at checkout can differ from the amount charged
detail: The cart keeps a copy of each price and stock count in the browser (localStorage 'ration.cart') and never refreshes it. The server's place_order re-prices from the database without checking against the total the customer saw, so for cash and wallet orders the customer can be charged a different amount from the 'Place order · ₹X' button. This will happen as soon as the 1,253 sample prices are replaced. Reorder makes it worse: it fills the cart with old order prices and a made-up stock of 50, and a cart from one store is checked out against a different store after the location changes.
evidence: apps/web/src/stores/cart.ts (persist with no refresh step); account/orders/[id]/page.tsx:75 (available: 50, old unit_price); checkout/page.tsx builds the bill from cart lines; supabase/functions/place-order/index.ts has no expected-total check
verifier_note: stores/cart.ts keeps price and available in localStorage ('ration.cart') with no refresh step, and add() on an existing line only raises the quantity. place-order/index.ts and place_order (0003:111-174) re-price from the database and never compare against the total the customer saw. Reorder (account/orders/[id]/page.tsx:75) uses the old unit_price and available: 50. Checkout uses the store from location (checkout/page.tsx:29, 55) rather than cart.storeId, and that store object, with its fees, is also stale in localStorage ('ration.location'). The fix is small: send the expected total and reject on mismatch, and refresh cart lines on checkout. It matters at launch because fresh produce prices change daily.

title: Store-side cancellation never refunds online (Razorpay) payments
detail: The admin asks 'Cancel this order and refund the customer?' but calls the staff_cancel_order RPC directly. cancel_order refunds only wallet payments in SQL; for Razorpay it just returns refund_online, and the admin ignores that value. The payment stays 'captured', no refunds row is written, and the customer's push says 'Any payment is being refunded'. This must be fixed before any online payment is switched on.

evidence: apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx:81 (confirm text). packages/api/src/admin.ts orders.cancel -> rpc staff_cancel_order. supabase/migrations/0003_orders_rpc.sql cancel_order (refund_online only computed for razorpay). The only gateway refund call is in supabase/functions/cancel-order/index.ts, which hard-codes p_by_customer: true, so staff cannot use it. supabase/functions/notify-order/index.ts MESSAGES.cancelled.
verifier_note: Correct. apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx:81 and the board's Cancel button in orders/page.tsx call admin.orders.cancel, which calls the staff_cancel_order RPC (0005). That runs cancel_order (0003_orders_rpc.sql), which refunds wallet payments in SQL but for Razorpay only returns refund_online, and the admin ignores the return value. The only gateway refund is in supabase/functions/cancel-order/index.ts, which hard-codes p_by_customer: true, and its RPC rejects actors who are not the order's customer. The push text in notify-order MESSAGES.cancelled says 'Any payment is being refunded'. docs/FEATURE_PARITY.md says refunds go through 'SQL + Razorpay refund API', which is true for customer cancellations only. COD and wallet cancellations work today. Priority lowered: launch is expected to be cash or UPI on delivery, so this blocks switching online payments on rather than launch itself. Fix it before Razorpay goes live, or hide the online option.

title: No alert when a new order arrives, and no escalation
detail: The board refreshes quietly on Realtime: no sound, no browser notification, no tab-title count. Orders stay 'placed' until someone clicks Accept, and nothing escalates an order that nobody has accepted. With a 15-minute promise, a missed order breaks the delivery promise.
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx useEffect only calls invalidateQueries. grep 'Audio|Notification|sound' in apps/admin/src finds nothing. packages/api/src/status.ts NEXT_STATUS placed->accepted is manual. stores.promised_minutes defaults to 15 (0001_init.sql).
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx only invalidates queries on a Realtime event, with refetchInterval 20s. There is no Audio, Notification or document.title code in apps/admin/src. The only cue is a red border once promised_at has passed. Nothing auto-accepts or escalates 'placed' orders: auto-assign in 0007 starts only at packing. Adding a sound and a tab-title count is a small, cheap job worth doing before launch. An SMS or WhatsApp escalation can come later.

title: No stock receiving, no stock movement history, and stock edits can overwrite deliveries
detail: staff_set_stock writes an absolute quantity using the number loaded when the page opened. If deliveries reduce stock in the meantime, a staff member entering the new total after receiving goods wipes out those reductions. There are no purchase orders or goods receipts, suppliers, cost price, batch or expiry dates, or reasons for write-offs (damage, expiry), so there is no margin data and no expiry control for food.
needs_from_owner: Supplier list, and whether to track cost price and expiry from day one.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_set_stock (quantity = excluded.quantity). apps/admin/src/app/inventory/page.tsx StockRow holds the loaded qty. 0003 advance_order decrements quantity on delivery. grep for purchase|supplier|stock_movements|expiry|cost_price in migrations finds nothing.
verifier_note: Confirmed. staff_set_stock (0005) writes an absolute quantity. advance_order (0003) decrements quantity on delivery. The CSV import (0010) also sets stock absolutely. The race is worse than described: in apps/admin/src/app/inventory/page.tsx, StockRow seeds useState(String(quantity)) once, and key=p.id never changes, so after a refetch the input keeps the old number. 'dirty' then turns true and Save writes that stale value. There are no purchase, supplier, stock-movement, cost-price or expiry tables. Minimum fix: a 'receive +N' action that adds to stock, plus a stock movements log.

title: Categories page cannot show or create the third level (subcategories)
detail: The catalogue is department -> category -> subcategory, and products sit on subcategories. The page lists only top-level rows and their direct children, and the Parent dropdown offers only top-level rows. So subcategories can be neither seen, edited nor created, and the CSV import needs subcategory slugs that already exist, meaning a new shelf needs SQL. The icon and description fields added in 0009 cannot be edited, and there is no delete or reorder.
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/categories/page.tsx: parents = filter(!c.parent_id), table = parents.flatMap(p => [p, ...children of p]), Parent <Select> uses parents only. supabase/migrations/0009_catalog_structure.sql adds description and icon. seeds/catalog.sql has 253 categories.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/src/app/categories/page.tsx sets parents = filter(!c.parent_id), the table shows only parents and their direct children, and the Parent select lists only top-level rows. The seed (supabase/seeds/catalog.sql) is department -> category -> subcategory, with products on subcategories. The CSV importer needs existing subcategory slugs, so adding a new shelf needs SQL. description and icon (0009) are not editable, and there is no delete or reorder. The admin select omits description and icon, so saves do not wipe them.

title: Product form is missing catalogue fields and bulk tools
detail: The single-product form cannot set brand, orderable ('Coming soon'), image credit (needed for openly licensed photos) or extra shelves (product_categories). The category dropdown is a flat list of all 253 categories, so a product can be put on a department. The GST rate is free text with no slab check, even though the importer checks 0/5/12/18/28/40. There is no HSN code column, no brands page (827 brands), no 'missing photo' filter for the 811 products without one, and no product CSV export for bulk price edits.
needs_from_owner: HSN codes per product (accountant).
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/products/page.tsx ProductForm fields and category <Select>. packages/api/src/admin.ts ProductRow has no orderable, image_credit or brand handling. products/import/page.tsx TAX set. apps/admin/src/lib/csv.ts downloadCsv is used only for the template and subcategory list.
verifier_note: Partly wrong. The CSV import already handles most of the missing fields. products/import/page.tsx and staff_import_products (0010) set brand (and create new brands), orderable, image_credit, image_url, several shelves, stock, and check the GST slab (0/5/12/18/28/40). Only the single-product form in apps/admin/src/app/products/page.tsx lacks them. It also has a flat category list that allows a department, and free-text GST. Still missing: HSN column, brands page, 'no photo' filter, catalogue CSV export (downloadCsv in lib/csv.ts is used only for the template and the subcategory list), and the 1,000-row cap from item 1. The export matters because the 1,253 sample prices must be replaced through the CSV import (catalog.sql:3).

title: No invoices, and GST rate is not saved on order lines
detail: No invoice or bill is generated or printable anywhere, although the apps tell users their email is 'for order invoices'. order_items does not record the tax rate or HSN at the time of sale, so GST cannot be worked out correctly after a product's rate changes. The admin order page has no invoice download.
needs_from_owner: GSTIN, CIN, registered address, invoice numbering format, and the CA's advice on issuing a bill of supply before GST registration.
evidence: grep -i invoice finds only hint text in apps/web/src/app/account/page.tsx:28 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/profile.tsx:45. supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql order_items has unit_price, mrp and line_total only. packages/shared/src/company.ts has gstin null.
verifier_note: Confirmed. 'invoice' appears only in hint text: apps/web/src/app/account/page.tsx:28, apps/mobile/src/app/account/profile.tsx:43 and :45, and the privacy texts. order_items (0001) has unit_price, mrp and line_total, with no tax_rate or HSN. COMPANY.gstin is null in packages/shared/src/company.ts. Without a GSTIN only a bill of supply or receipt can be issued for now, so a full GST tax invoice can wait. Saving tax_rate on order_items is cheap and should be done before the first real order.

title: No reports, and the dashboard's 'today' uses UTC
detail: Reporting is limited to today's tiles. There is no date-range sales report, store or payment-method split, GST summary by rate, top products, cancellation reasons, rider performance, coupon cost, or CSV export. staff_dashboard counts 'today' from date_trunc('day', now()) in the database time zone, which is UTC on Supabase, and no Asia/Kolkata setting exists. Between 00:00 and 05:30 IST, 'today' therefore still includes the previous day's evening.
needs_from_owner: Which reports the accountant needs (sales register, GST summary).
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/page.tsx (tiles only). supabase/migrations/0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_dashboard. grep 'Asia/Kolkata|timezone' in supabase/ and apps/admin finds nothing. No reports route in apps/admin/src/app.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/src/app/page.tsx shows six tiles only. staff_dashboard (0005) uses date_trunc('day', now()). There is no Asia/Kolkata or timezone setting in supabase/, apps/admin or packages, and no reports route. The same UTC day boundary is in rider_summary (0006) and in auto-assign's 'delivered today' tie-break (0007). A daily sales and payment-method report with CSV export is what cash reconciliation and GST filing need. The UTC issue alone is minor.

title: Order history has no search, filters, pagination or export
detail: History shows only the latest 200 orders. Support cannot look up an order by order number or customer phone, filter by status, date or payment method, page back further, or export.
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/orders/history/page.tsx calls admin.orders.list({ limit: 200 }). packages/api/src/admin.ts orders.list supports only storeId, active and limit.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/src/app/orders/history/page.tsx calls admin.orders.list({ limit: 200 }). orders.list in packages/api/src/admin.ts accepts only storeId, active and limit. Looking up an order by number or phone is needed from day one for phone support.

title: Customer lookup and support tools are minimal
detail: The People page loads the 300 newest profiles and searches only those, in the browser. There is no customer detail page (orders, addresses, wallet history), no goodwill or refund wallet credit screen, no way to block a customer for COD abuse, and no internal notes on orders. A policy lets admins insert wallet_transactions, but nothing updates profiles.wallet_balance alongside it, so a direct insert would not change the balance.
needs_from_owner: Goodwill credit policy (limits, who may approve).
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/people/page.tsx calls admin.people.customers(300) with a client-side filter. supabase/migrations/0005_staff_rpcs.sql:133 'wallet staff insert' policy, with no matching RPC. There is no customers/[id] route.
verifier_note: Confirmed. apps/admin/src/app/people/page.tsx loads people.customers(300) and filters in the browser. There is no customers/[id] route and no block flag. 'wallet staff insert' (0005_staff_rpcs.sql:133) has no matching RPC, and no trigger keeps profiles.wallet_balance in sync, so an insert would not change the balance. Two more problems the reviewer missed. First, the same 300-row page is the only place to change roles, so after 300 newer signups an existing staff member or rider cannot be found to promote or demote. Second, the refund policy promises instant wallet credits (item 5), but there is no credit tool.

title: No rider management screen
detail: Riders are managed only through the role dropdown. The assignment dropdown lists every rider with no online, busy or distance information, even though rider_locations has is_online and the rider's location. There is no live rider map in the admin, declines are not shown, and there are no KYC or vehicle details (DL, RC, Aadhaar/PAN, bank), no suspend option and no performance view. Payouts are already a known item.
needs_from_owner: List of rider documents to collect and the onboarding checks.
evidence: apps/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx and orders/[id]/page.tsx rider <select> fed by admin.people.riders (profiles where role='rider'). supabase/migrations/0006_rider.sql adds rider_locations.is_online. 0007 order_rider_declines has a staff read policy but is unused in apps/admin.
verifier_note: Partly wrong: automatic assignment already exists and uses the online, busy and distance data the reviewer says is unused. supabase/migrations/0007_auto_assign.sql picks the nearest idle online rider with a fresh location within assign_radius_m when packing starts. A decline hands the order to the next rider, and waiting orders are picked up when a rider comes online or finishes. apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx exposes the auto-assign toggle and radius, and supabase/tests/smoke.sql covers it. What is still true: the manual dropdowns in orders/page.tsx and orders/[id]/page.tsx list every profile with role='rider' with no status. order_rider_declines is never shown in the admin. There is no live rider map in the admin, and no KYC, vehicle, bank, suspend or performance data.

title: Only one staff role, no per-store limits, and no audit log
detail: Roles are just store_staff and admin. profiles has no store_id, so any staff member sees and changes every store. There are no narrower roles such as packer, store manager or finance. Only order actions are logged (order_events); price, stock, coupon, store-setting and role changes leave no record of who made them.
needs_from_owner: Decide the staff roles and what each one may do.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql user_role enum, profiles table, and is_staff() used by every staff policy. grep 'audit' in supabase/migrations finds nothing. apps/admin/src/stores/auth.ts isStaff() is a two-role check.
verifier_note: Confirmed. The user_role enum and profiles in 0001 have no store_id. is_staff() covers both store_staff and admin, and every staff policy uses it. Only staff_set_role checks for admin. isStaff() in apps/admin/src/stores/auth.ts checks the two roles. The store picker in the admin is only a view filter. No audit table exists, and order_events covers order actions only. With a single store at launch, per-store limits can wait. Limiting price, coupon and fee writes to admins (item 3) and keeping a basic change log for prices, stock and cash are the parts that matter now.

title: Store hours are not enforced; no closures or editable fees
detail: place_order checks only stores.is_open and never opens_at or closes_at, so the hours entered in the admin are for display only and customers can order at 3am if the switch is left on. There is no weekly schedule, holiday closure or timed pause (for example in rain). The service_area polygon column cannot be edited, and latitude/longitude are typed by hand with no map. The handling fee is hard-coded at Rs 5 in SQL and in shared pricing. There is no settings page or table for the known payments on/off switch.
needs_from_owner: Store timings, holiday calendar and fee amounts.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0003_orders_rpc.sql:95 (only is_open) and :81 v_handling := 500. packages/shared/src/pricing.ts HANDLING_FEE. apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx form. stores.service_area exists in 0001_init.sql. grep app_settings in the repo finds nothing.
verifier_note: Hours part confirmed. place_order (0003_orders_rpc.sql:95) and find_serving_store (0002) check only is_open. opens_at and closes_at are never used outside the admin form (grep finds them in no app or edge function), so they are display-only. There is no weekly schedule, holiday closure or timed pause. service_area is not editable, and latitude and longitude are typed by hand. Correction to the title: delivery fee, minimum order and the free-delivery threshold are already editable per store in apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx. Only the Rs 5 handling fee and the Rs 20 small-order fee are hard-coded (0003 v_handling := 500 and 2000; packages/shared/src/pricing.ts HANDLING_FEE and SMALL_ORDER_FEE). There is no app_settings table yet for the payments on/off switch.

title: No automated tests for admin flows
detail: No end-to-end test covers staff login, the board, cancellation, rider assignment, stock edits or uploads. CI only lints and builds the admin, and smoke.sql tests only the import RPC, so a broken staff RPC or RLS policy would not be caught.
evidence: tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts (customer and rider tests only). .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint and build for @ration/admin). supabase/tests/smoke.sql (staff_import_products only).
verifier_note: Confirmed, with one correction. tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts covers customer flows only, and the rider step uses infra/opensource/simulate-rider.mjs with the service role. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) only lints and builds the admin. The correction: supabase/tests/smoke.sql tests more than the import RPC. It covers place_order, cancel_order (stock release, coupon reversal), advance_order (stock decrement, COD capture), auto-assign and decline, and execute privileges, in addition to staff_import_products. What is untested: the staff_* wrappers, all RLS policies (so the holes in item 3 went unnoticed), storage uploads (item 4) and the admin UI.

title: No bill or invoice: numbering, tax snapshot and document
detail: The Consumer Protection Act 2019 treats not issuing a bill or receipt as an unfair trade practice, and the privacy page promises invoices are kept, but none exist. order_items does not store tax_rate, HSN or taxable value. orders has no tax totals. order_number comes from a global sequence that rolled-back and cancelled orders also use up, so it cannot serve as a gap-free per-financial-year invoice series. Needs an invoices table with a per-FY sequence, a tax split per line and for fees, and PDF generation and delivery. Without a GSTIN this would be a bill of supply until registration.
needs_from_owner: GSTIN (or confirm unregistered/bill of supply), registered address, invoice format
evidence: 0001_init.sql:158 products.tax_rate is the only tax field. order_items columns (0001_init.sql ~260) have no tax. :238 order_number_seq. grep invoice/hsn in supabase: none. packages/shared/src/company.ts gstin null.
verifier_note: Partly done. An itemised on-screen bill does exist on each order: apps/web/src/app/account/orders/[id]/page.tsx:119 (BillRows) and apps/mobile/src/app/order/[id].tsx:181 (BillSummary), with order_number as a unique reference. Missing: seller details on it (COMPANY address, CIN and GSTIN are all null in packages/shared/src/company.ts), any PDF, email or SMS document, and tax fields on order_items (0001:269-280, where products.tax_rate at :158 is the only tax field). order_number_seq (:238) is global and has gaps, so it cannot serve as a per-financial-year series. With no GSTIN, a consumer receipt is enough; the business is not issuing GST invoices or bills of supply yet. So 'receipt with seller details plus share or print' is a small pre-launch task. The full invoices table with a per-FY series and tax split becomes a blocker the day the GSTIN arrives. Have a CA confirm the GST position.

title: Webhook can lose payments: event recorded before it is handled, errors ignored
detail: razorpay-webhook inserts into webhook_events first and never checks the result of db.rpc('confirm_payment'). If confirm fails, it still returns 200 and Razorpay's retry is dropped as a duplicate, so a paid order stays pending_payment. payment.authorized and refund.failed are not handled, and payment.failed does not release the stock. Must be fixed before online payments are switched on.
evidence: supabase/functions/razorpay-webhook/index.ts:36 inserts the event before :47 rpc, whose result is not checked. Only the payment.captured, payment.failed and refund.processed branches exist.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/functions/razorpay-webhook/index.ts:36 inserts webhook_events first. The supabase-js rpc at :47 returns {error} rather than throwing, and the code never checks it, so a failed confirm still returns 200 and the retry is dropped as a duplicate at :37. If the X-Razorpay-Event-Id header is missing, a random UUID disables dedupe (:34). Two corrections: payment.authorized only matters if auto-capture is off, and releasing stock on payment.failed would be wrong because Razorpay lets the customer retry on the same order. The right release is time-based expiry (gap 11). Matters only once online payments are switched on.

title: Money paid after a cancellation, or paid twice, is never refunded
detail: If a customer cancels a pending_payment order and the payment is captured later (or the webhook arrives after a staff cancel), confirm_payment marks the payment captured but the order stays cancelled and no refund is issued. A second payment on the same order is ignored because the payment row is already 'captured'. Both need an automatic refund path.
evidence: 0003_orders_rpc.sql confirm_payment (does not check order status before setting captured; returns the existing status). cancel_order sets refund_online only when the payment is already captured.
verifier_note: Confirmed for the realistic path. confirm_payment (0003:252-265) sets payments to captured without checking that the order is cancelled, then returns 'cancelled' with no refund. This really happens: both checkouts call cancel-order when the Razorpay modal is dismissed (apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx:62, apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx:78), while a UPI-intent payment can still complete later. 'Paid twice' is rarer, because Razorpay blocks a second payment on a paid order except for late-authorised UPI edge cases. A second payment would be silently ignored by the status<>'captured' filter. Online payments only.

title: Staff cancellation never refunds online payments, and failed refunds are never retried
detail: The admin 'Cancel order and refund the customer' button calls the staff_cancel_order RPC directly and throws away refund_online, so a prepaid order cancelled by the store is never refunded through Razorpay. In cancel-order, if the Razorpay refund call fails after the DB cancel has committed, nothing is recorded and nothing retries.
evidence: packages/api/src/admin.ts orders.cancel (ignores data). apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx:32,81. supabase/functions/cancel-order/index.ts (refund after RPC, no failed-refund row or retry).
verifier_note: Confirmed. packages/api/src/admin.ts:150-152 calls the staff_cancel_order RPC and discards the returned refund_online. apps/admin/src/app/orders/[id]/page.tsx:32,81 labels the button 'Cancel this order and refund the customer?'. After a staff cancel, the payment row stays 'captured' with no refunds row, so nothing shows that money is owed. In supabase/functions/cancel-order/index.ts:29-40 a Razorpay refund failure throws after the DB cancel has committed; no pending or failed refund row is written and nothing retries. Online payments only.

title: No scheduled jobs: unpaid orders hold stock forever
detail: There is no pg_cron or scheduled function. Abandoned pending_payment orders keep stock reserved and the coupon used indefinitely. Nothing alerts on orders stuck in 'placed', and nothing purges idempotency_keys or webhook_events.
evidence: grep pg_cron/cron.schedule across the repo: none. place_order reserves stock at 0003_orders_rpc.sql:124-133. No expiry logic in any migration.
verifier_note: Confirmed. There is no pg_cron, cron.schedule or scheduled function anywhere (the only workflow schedules are for catalogue photos). place_order reserves stock at 0003:124-131, and only cancel_order releases it. Nothing expires pending_payment orders, alerts on orders stuck in 'placed', or purges idempotency_keys and webhook_events. Under a COD-only launch, pending_payment orders come mainly from the gap-2 bug, so fixing gap 2 cuts most of the impact until online payments go live.

title: Order status steps not enforced for staff
detail: staff_advance_order and advance_order never check the current status. Staff can move an unpaid pending_payment order to accepted or delivered, reopen a cancelled order, or mark 'delivered' twice, which subtracts stock twice. The 'orders staff update' policy also lets staff edit totals or status directly through the API.
evidence: 0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_advance_order (only blocks the cancelled, refunded and pending_payment targets). 0003_orders_rpc.sql advance_order runs the inventory decrement on every 'delivered' call. 0001_init.sql:451.
verifier_note: Confirmed. staff_advance_order (0005:4-19) checks only the target status. advance_order (0003:333-356) never checks the current status and runs the inventory decrement on every 'delivered' call. The admin UI limits steps through NEXT_STATUS (packages/api/src/status.ts:42), but that is client-side only. A realistic double decrement: the rider marks delivered (rider_advance_order in 0006 does enforce steps), then staff on a stale board click 'Mark delivered' again. 'orders staff update' (0001:451) allows direct edits to total and status through PostgREST.

title: No refunds after delivery, missing-item handling or wallet credits
detail: Nothing handles a damaged or missing item after delivery, removing an out-of-stock item while packing, or a partial refund. The 'refunded' status is never set. The 'wallet staff insert' policy lets admins add a wallet_transactions row without changing wallet_balance, so goodwill credits would leave the ledger and balance out of step.
needs_from_owner: Return / refund policy (also needed for the Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules)
evidence: grep 'refunded' in migrations: only exclusion lists. 0005_staff_rpcs.sql:133 policy with no balance trigger. No order-item edit RPC. The admin app has no wallet-credit UI.
verifier_note: Confirmed. 'refunded' appears only in exclusion lists and the enum; no code sets it. No RPC exists to edit, remove or partly refund an order item. 'wallet staff insert' (0005:133) lets an admin insert ledger rows without touching profiles.wallet_balance, and apps/admin has no wallet-credit UI. With COD, a missing item at the door also leaves the rider to collect the wrong total.

title: Store opening hours are stored but never enforced
detail: Admins set opens_at and closes_at, but place_order and find_serving_store check only is_open. Orders are accepted at 3 a.m. unless staff remember to switch the store off. Needs an IST time-window check, plus a 'next opening' response to show customers.
evidence: 0003_orders_rpc.sql:95 checks only v_store.is_open. 0002_lat_lng_columns.sql find_serving_store has 'where s.is_open'. Admin edits the hours at apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx:29-30.
verifier_note: Confirmed. place_order checks only v_store.is_open (0003:95). find_serving_store filters on 'where s.is_open' (0002). opens_at and closes_at are only edited and displayed in apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx:29-30,56, and no customer app reads them. Also, because find_serving_store hides closed stores, customers see 'not serviceable' instead of 'closed, opens at X'.

title: Notification gaps: COD orders, store alerts, web users, SMS/WhatsApp/email
detail: orders_notify fires only AFTER UPDATE, so COD and wallet orders, which are inserted already 'placed', get no confirmation. Store staff get no new-order alert unless the admin tab is open. Website users get nothing because only Expo or ntfy push exists. There are no SMS, WhatsApp or email order updates or receipts, no messages for 'ready' or 'refunded', and no notification log or retry (pg_net failures are lost).
needs_from_owner: WhatsApp Business / MSG91 templates (DLT-approved) for order updates. Transactional email provider
evidence: 0008_notify_trigger.sql:80 'after update'. 0003_orders_rpc.sql inserts COD orders with status 'placed'. supabase/functions/notify-order/index.ts MESSAGES has no 'ready' or 'refunded', sendTo is push only.
verifier_note: Confirmed with refinements. orders_notify is AFTER UPDATE only (0008:80). COD and wallet orders are inserted as 'placed' (0003:181), and nothing updates them afterwards, so the main launch payment method gets no confirmation push. The admin board does refresh live through Realtime (apps/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx:68), but it has no sound or desktop alert. Web users do see live status on an open order page (apps/web/src/app/account/orders/[id]/page.tsx:46), so they do not get 'nothing', but there is no notification when the page is closed. notify-order MESSAGES has no 'ready' or 'refunded', sendTo is push only, and there is no notification log; pg_net responses are never read.

title: OTP abuse protection and WhatsApp OTP
detail: No CAPTCHA (Turnstile/hCaptcha) on OTP requests and no per-number or per-IP limits beyond the dashboard defaults, so SMS-pumping fraud can run up MSG91 bills. The send-sms hook only calls MSG91's SMS OTP API. The WhatsApp-first login with SMS fallback (known item) is not started, and optional verified email (known) has no verification flow: profiles.email is free text.
needs_from_owner: DLT registration and template, WhatsApp Business account / authentication template, Turnstile site key
evidence: grep captcha/turnstile: none. supabase/config.toml [auth.sms] max_frequency 1s (local) and no [auth.captcha]. supabase/functions/send-sms/index.ts (single MSG91 /api/v5/otp call). 0001_init.sql profiles.email.
verifier_note: Confirmed. There is no captcha or turnstile anywhere, and config.toml has no [auth.captcha] or [auth.rate_limit]. supabase/functions/send-sms/index.ts makes one MSG91 /api/v5/otp call and does not restrict numbers to +91, which is the main SMS-pumping vector. There is no WhatsApp channel or fallback logic. profiles.email is plain text with no verification, edited directly from apps/web/src/app/account/page.tsx:28 and apps/mobile/src/app/account/profile.tsx:45. Production rate limits must be raised for real traffic (see gap 7) at the same time CAPTCHA is added.

title: Order and COD abuse controls
detail: place-order has no rate limit, no cap on open COD orders and no customer block flag, so one account can reserve whole shelves with fake COD orders or keep refusing at the door. Referral pays ₹50 to both sides on any delivered order, with no minimum value. Idempotency is check-then-insert, so a fast double tap can create two orders.
needs_from_owner: Business rules: max open COD orders, minimum order value for referral
evidence: supabase/functions/place-order/index.ts:41-81 (select then upsert, no lock or limit). profiles has no blocked column (grep blocked/banned: none). 0004_referrals_reviews_search.sql reward_referral_on_delivery has no order-value check.
verifier_note: Confirmed, plus a worse idempotency problem than the reviewer found. place-order (supabase/functions/place-order/index.ts:40-43, 79-82) does a select, then the RPC, then an upsert, with no lock and no rate limit. There is no open-COD cap and no blocked flag (grep: none). reward_referral_on_delivery (0004) has no minimum order value. New finding: both clients generate a fresh idempotency key on every non-cancel error (apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx:81, apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx:96). If the request times out on a weak network but succeeded on the server, the retry creates a second order. Double taps are already blocked in the UI by the button's loading state.

title: Staff permissions too broad, and no audit log
detail: is_staff() treats store_staff the same as admin for prices, coupons, stores, banners, all orders and all customer phones and addresses, with no link from staff to a store. Changes to prices, stock, coupons and roles leave no record. Only order_events tracks order changes.
needs_from_owner: Decide role matrix (admin / store manager / packer)
evidence: 0001_init.sql 'staff write' policies use is_staff(). 0005_staff_rpcs.sql 'addresses staff read'. No staff-store table and no audit table (grep audit: none).
verifier_note: Confirmed. Every 'staff write' policy (0001:432-438), 'addresses staff read' (0005:132), staff_import_products (0010) and staff_set_stock use is_staff(), which treats store_staff the same as admin. There is no staff-to-store link and no audit table (grep audit: none). Existing protection: staff_set_role is admin-only and guards the last admin (0005). Only order_events records history.

title: No inventory movement history
detail: staff_set_stock and the CSV import overwrite the absolute quantity, with no record of goods received, wastage, expiry or count adjustments. A recount entered while deliveries are in progress can double-count, and shrinkage cannot be traced.
evidence: 0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_set_stock (upsert quantity). 0010_product_import.sql stock overwrite. No stock_movements table in migrations.
verifier_note: Confirmed. staff_set_stock (0005) and the CSV import (0010, the 'stock' upsert) overwrite quantity. No stock_movements table exists. A recount that excludes packed but undelivered bags is subtracted again at delivery by advance_order, so stock goes down twice (the reviewer's 'double-count').

title: DPDP: consent records, data export and retention
detail: No record of which privacy notice or terms version a user accepted, no marketing opt-in flag, no self-service data export, and no retention purge (address_snapshot, order_events, idempotency_keys and webhook_events are kept forever). Check the DPDP Rules' phased start dates when planning.
needs_from_owner: Privacy notice text, retention periods, grievance officer (company.ts is null)
evidence: grep consent in migrations/apps: none. profiles has no terms or consent columns. No export RPC or function.
verifier_note: Confirmed. Login shows only 'By continuing you agree...' text (apps/mobile/src/app/(auth)/index.tsx:62, apps/web/src/app/login/page.tsx:65). Nothing stores which version was accepted, there is no marketing opt-in column, and there is no export RPC or purge job. Most substantive DPDP Rules duties are phased to start about 18 months after the November 2025 notification (around May 2027). So this is not a day-one blocker, but cheap consent capture should go in early.

title: Test coverage misses security and payment-failure paths
detail: smoke.sql runs as superuser, so no RLS policy is ever tested; a test as role 'authenticated' would have caught the wallet_balance hole. Edge functions are only type-checked: there are no deno tests for the webhook, signature failure, refunds or idempotency. E2E has 3 web tests and none for admin or rider. CI uses Postgres 16 while config.toml says 17.
evidence: supabase/tests/smoke.sql (no 'set role'). .github/workflows/ci.yml functions job runs only 'deno check' and uses image postgis/postgis:16-3.4 vs supabase/config.toml major_version = 17. tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts has 3 tests.
verifier_note: Confirmed with nuance. supabase/tests/smoke.sql only sets request.jwt.claim.sub and never runs SET ROLE, so RLS is never exercised. It does assert some function privileges through has_function_privilege (around line 94). The CI functions job only runs deno check (.github/workflows/ci.yml:39), and there are no deno tests. tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts has 3 tests and is the only spec. Only the smoke job uses postgis/postgis:16-3.4 (ci.yml:46); the e2e job runs scripts/oss-start.mjs (Supabase CLI, Postgres 17 per config.toml).

title: Monitoring and alerting for backend errors
detail: Edge functions only console.error, and nothing reports failures from pg_net calls, refunds, the webhook or auto-assignment. With money flows involved, someone needs an alert when a refund or confirmation fails.
needs_from_owner: Choose an error-tracking/alerting tool and who receives alerts
evidence: supabase/functions/_shared/http.ts errorResponse (console.error only). grep sentry/logflare: none. net._http_response is never read.
verifier_note: Confirmed. supabase/functions/_shared/http.ts:24 only calls console.error. There is no Sentry, Logflare or similar anywhere. net._http_response is never read, and auto-assignment and refund failures go unreported.

title: No batch or expiry tracking, and no minimum shelf-life check
detail: Stock is a single number per product per store. Nothing records batches or expiry dates, warns about stock close to expiry, picks the earliest expiry first, or handles recalls. FSSAI expects e-commerce food businesses to deliver food with at least 30% of its shelf life (or 45 days) left. Food regulators have acted against quick-commerce dark stores over expired stock.
evidence: supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql: the inventory table only has quantity, reserved and price_override. A search for expiry, best_before, batch and shelf life across supabase/migrations, packages/api/src and apps/admin/src finds nothing. 0005_staff_rpcs.sql staff_set_stock overwrites one quantity.

title: Delivery time is a fixed promise with no capacity check
detail: Every screen shows 'Delivery in N minutes' from a fixed store setting. Orders are taken no matter how many riders are online or how many orders are waiting. If no rider is free, the order sits in the pool silently, and no one is told when the promised time passes. There is no busy, rain or overload mode, and no delay message or compensation. In early 2026 the government also pressed quick-commerce firms to stop advertising fixed delivery minutes because of rider safety, so a hard number is a legal and reputational risk.
needs_from_owner: Policy decision: show a time range or a fixed number, and when to pause or throttle ordering
evidence: stores.promised_minutes (default 15) is shown in apps/web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx, CartDrawer.tsx, apps/web/src/app/checkout/page.tsx, apps/mobile/src/app/cart.tsx and apps/mobile/src/components/home/DeliveryHeader.tsx. 0003_orders_rpc.sql place_order sets promised_at = now() + promised_minutes with no capacity check. 0007_auto_assign.sql auto_assign_rider just returns null when no rider is free. notify-order has no 'delayed' message.

title: Delivery zones can only be circles
detail: The database supports a polygon service area, but the admin can only set a radius. In a city like Bengaluru a circle crosses lakes, railway lines, flyovers and gated campuses that riders cannot reach in time. There is no way to draw the zone or mark no-go pockets.
needs_from_owner: The exact area the owner wants each dark store to serve
evidence: 0001_init.sql/0002 find_serving_store checks stores.service_area (polygon) before service_radius_m. apps/admin/src/app/stores/page.tsx only edits 'Service radius (m)', with no map or polygon editor. supabase/seed.sql creates stores by radius only.

title: No order weight or size limits for two-wheeler delivery
detail: A customer can order up to 50 of every item, with no limit on the number of lines. Products have no weight, so the system cannot stop an order a bike rider cannot carry, or one that empties a store's stock of a deal item. This is about physical capacity and per-item caps, which is separate from the COD and fraud abuse item.
needs_from_owner: Maximum bag weight per rider and any per-item purchase limits
evidence: apps/mobile/src/stores/cart.ts MAX_PER_LINE = 50. 0001_init.sql cart_items has quantity <= 50. 0003_orders_rpc.sql place_order only rejects quantity > 50. No weight column on products. Example: 50 x 'Pillsbury Whole Wheat Atta 5 kg' (250 kg) is accepted.

title: Product records lack barcode, cost price, weight and storage temperature
detail: These are operational fields, separate from the legal declarations and the admin form gaps already listed. Without barcode/EAN or SKU codes, staff cannot scan when receiving or picking, so wrong items go out. Without cost price there is no margin or stock valuation. Without weight there are no order weight limits. Without storage type (frozen, chilled, room temperature), ice cream and frozen items, which can be ordered today, cannot be flagged for insulated bags or packed last.
needs_from_owner: Supplier data: EAN barcodes and purchase cost prices
evidence: 0001_init.sql products columns. 0010_product_import.sql staff_import_products accepts no such fields. apps/admin/src/app/products/page.tsx form fields (name, slug, category, unit label, MRP, price, GST, tags, diet, active). A search for barcode, ean, sku, cost_price, weight and storage across supabase/migrations, packages/api/src and apps/admin/src finds nothing. supabase/catalog/products/ice-creams-more.json items are orderable.

title: Gig-worker law compliance for delivery partners (Karnataka Act, Social Security Code)
detail: The first store is in Bengaluru. Two laws need checking with a lawyer: the Karnataka Platform-based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Act 2025, and the Code on Social Security, in force since November 2025. They are expected to require registering the company and its riders, paying a welfare fee or contribution on rider payouts, written terms, notice and reasons before deactivating a rider, and explaining automated job assignment to riders. The code has nothing for any of this. The existing KYC, agreement and payout items cover onboarding and pay, not these legal duties.
needs_from_owner: Legal advice and registration with the Karnataka welfare board and the central portal; insurance cover for riders
evidence: supabase/seed.sql store at 12.9716, 77.5946 (Bengaluru). Riders are customer profiles with role 'rider' (README 'Staff access'), with no contract, deactivation or registration records. 0007_auto_assign.sql assignment rules (nearest rider, decline history) are never shown to riders. There is no per-job payout ledger to calculate a fee on. A search for 'gig', 'welfare' and 'social security' finds nothing.

title: Unbranded staples need packer registration and printed labels if RATION packs them
detail: About 210 listings have no brand but come in fixed packs (rice, pulses and flours in 500 g or 1 kg). Whoever packs them needs Legal Metrology packer registration, and each pack needs a printed label with packer name and address, net quantity, MRP, packing date and customer care, plus FSSAI labelling. The known item covers declarations on the product page, not physical labels, label printing or packing-date records.
needs_from_owner: Decide between packing in-house and buying pre-packed from suppliers; packer registration and an FSSAI licence that covers repacking
