evidence: packages/api/src/rider.ts history(limit = 50); RIDER_NEXT has no arrival steps; no rating table for riders in supabase/migrations
verifier_note: The only rating table is product_reviews (0001 and 0004). RIDER_NEXT has no 'arrived' steps. history(limit = 50) in packages/api/src/rider.ts has no date filter or earnings. A grep for shift or incentive in the migrations finds nothing.

title: Rider app and most rider RPCs are not tested
detail: smoke.sql tests automatic assignment and decline, but not rider_claim_order (two riders racing for one order, the 3-order cap), rider_advance_order transitions or rider_summary. The end-to-end tests cover only the website storefront, and CI only typechecks and lints the rider app.
evidence: supabase/tests/smoke.sql (no rider_claim_order/rider_advance_order/rider_summary); tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts only; .github/workflows/ci.yml lint -w @ration/rider
verifier_note: supabase/tests/smoke.sql covers auto-assign, rider_decline_order and rider_set_online(true) picking up waiting orders. It does not cover rider_claim_order (the race or the 3-order cap), rider_advance_order transitions or rider_summary. tests/e2e has only storefront.spec.ts. .github/workflows/ci.yml typechecks all workspaces and lints @ration/rider but never builds it. The claim race is already safe by design: an atomic UPDATE ... WHERE rider_id IS NULL.

title: SEO basics: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, per-page titles and link previews
detail: There is no robots.ts, sitemap.ts, metadataBase or canonical URL. Every product and category page has the same default title because those pages run in the browser and export no metadata. There is no Open Graph or Twitter image, so a product link shared on WhatsApp shows no picture or price.
needs_from_owner: Final domain and Google Search Console verification
evidence: Searching apps/web/src for openGraph, twitter, generateMetadata, robots, sitemap, metadataBase and canonical found nothing; layout.tsx has only title, description and applicationName; env.siteUrl is never used
verifier_note: layout.tsx metadata has only title, description and applicationName. No robots.ts, sitemap.ts, metadataBase, canonical, openGraph or twitter entries exist, and env.siteUrl is unused. The policy pages do set their own titles; product and category pages cannot, because they are 'use client'. Downgraded to later: catalogue pages are hidden behind the location gate anyway (item 21), and real per-product titles and previews need server rendering. robots.ts and sitemap.ts are quick wins once the domain is fixed.

title: Heavy, hot-linked product images and browser-only rendering hurt speed
detail: Product photos load straight from openfoodfacts.org and wikimedia.org (Wikimedia ones are 960px wide) with optimisation switched off ('unoptimized') and are shown at 140px. Every catalogue page is an empty page with a spinner until the location and Supabase calls finish, and category pages load up to 200 products at once without paging.
evidence: supabase/seeds/catalog.sql (333 openfoodfacts.org and 164 thumb.wikimedia.org image URLs, '960px-' thumbnails); 'unoptimized' in components/catalog/ProductCard.tsx; category/[slug]/page.tsx (limit 200 or 120); all catalogue pages start with 'use client'
verifier_note: supabase/seeds/catalog.sql links 333 images.openfoodfacts.org, 164 thumb.wikimedia.org (97 of them '960px-'), 99 openbeautyfacts and 24 openproductsfacts URLs. ProductCard.tsx:21 uses 'unoptimized'. catalogApi.products defaults to 200 (packages/api/src/catalog.ts:108), and category/[slug]/page.tsx:34 asks for 200 or 120. Downgraded: these are sample photos that will be replaced, and the admin panel already uploads to a Supabase Storage bucket ('product-images', supabase/config.toml:70; packages/api/src/admin.ts:257). Real photos should be resized on upload or served through image transforms.

title: Catalogue pages that search engines can read, plus structured data
detail: Home, category, product and search pages are all behind StoreGate, so a crawler without a location only sees 'Where should we deliver?'. Products are already public in the database, so server-rendered product and category pages with Product, BreadcrumbList and Organization structured data could rank in search without a location.
evidence: apps/web/src/components/catalog/StoreGate.tsx; supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:427 ('products public read'); no ld+json or schema.org in apps/web/src
verifier_note: StoreGate.tsx wraps home, category, product and search pages, so a visitor with no location sees only 'Where should we deliver?'. Products, categories and inventory are publicly readable (0001_init.sql:424-428). apps/web/src has no ld+json or schema.org.

title: Cookie and consent banner
detail: Today the site only uses necessary storage (Supabase auth cookies and the cart and location in browser storage), which the privacy policy should mention. A consent banner, plus DPDP Act notice and consent withdrawal, becomes necessary once analytics or ad pixels are added.
needs_from_owner: Decide which analytics or marketing tools will be used
evidence: No consent code in apps/web/src; stores/cart.ts and stores/location.ts use localStorage; privacy/page.tsx says nothing about cookies
verifier_note: apps/web/src has no consent code. Today it stores only what the site needs to work: Supabase auth cookies (lib/supabase.ts, createBrowserClient), 'ration.cart' and 'ration.location' in localStorage, and 'ration.pendingOrder' in sessionStorage (lib/payments.ts:40). The privacy wording belongs in item 1; a banner is needed only once analytics is added.

title: Installable web app (PWA) and app links
detail: There is no web manifest, no 192/512 icons or apple-touch-icon, and favicon.ico is the same file as the admin panel's. There is no 'Get the app' banner and no assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association for app deep links.
needs_from_owner: Brand logo files
evidence: No manifest.ts in apps/web/src/app or apps/web/public; md5 of apps/web/src/app/favicon.ico matches apps/admin/src/app/favicon.ico; apps/mobile/app.json has no associatedDomains or intentFilters
verifier_note: There is no manifest, and apps/web/public contains only maplibre/. favicon.ico has the same md5 as the admin panel's (2be26fb5...), but it is a 15 KB custom icon, not the Next.js default, so sharing it is cosmetic. apps/mobile/app.json has scheme 'ration' but no associatedDomains or intentFilters, and there is no assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association.

title: Accessibility fixes
detail: The cart drawer and location pop-up do not keep keyboard focus inside, cannot be closed with Escape, and do not return focus when closed. The +/− buttons say 'Add one' or 'Remove one' without the product name, and a bin emoji stands in for 'remove'. Cancelling an order uses the browser's alert() and confirm(), the veg/non-veg mark is an emoji instead of the FSSAI symbol, and there is no skip-to-content link.
evidence: No Escape or keydown handling in apps/web/src; components/cart/CartDrawer.tsx; components/catalog/ProductCard.tsx (aria-labels); account/orders/[id]/page.tsx (alert/confirm); product/[slug]/page.tsx (veg emoji)
verifier_note: apps/web/src has no Escape or keydown handling. CartDrawer.tsx:19 has role='dialog' without aria-modal and no focus trap. The +/− buttons use 'Remove one' and 'Add one' without the product name (ProductCard.tsx:40-42, CartDrawer.tsx:43-45), and CartDrawer.tsx:43 shows a bin emoji. account/orders/[id]/page.tsx:63 and :99 use alert() and confirm(), product/[slug]/page.tsx:52 uses emoji veg marks, and there is no skip link.

title: Ratings and support page behind the app
detail: The app lets customers rate items from delivered orders (RateItem) and has a FAQ plus WhatsApp and call buttons. The website has none of these, and rating_avg and rating_count are never shown on any product. The contact page shows the phone number as plain text with no wa.me or tel: link (in-app chat is a known open item).
evidence: apps/mobile/src/components/orders/RateItem.tsx and apps/mobile/src/app/account/support.tsx versus apps/web/src/app/contact/page.tsx; supabase/migrations/0004_referrals_reviews_search.sql:77 (rating columns)
verifier_note: apps/mobile/src/components/orders/RateItem.tsx is used in apps/mobile/src/app/order/[id].tsx:174, and apps/mobile/src/app/account/support.tsx has the FAQ plus wa.me and call buttons (hidden until supportPhone is set). The web has none of these, and contact/page.tsx:13 prints the phone as plain text. One correction: rating_avg and rating_count (0004:77) are not shown in the app either, so that part is not a gap specific to the website.

title: Hindi and regional languages
detail: The website is English only (lang="en", all text written directly into the pages), so there is nothing in place for Hindi or other Indian languages.

evidence: apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx (html lang="en"); no translation library in apps/web/package.json
